appDescription.message: Chat with your ibl.ai agents from a Chrome side panel, on any page, and let them browse for you.

errorAccess.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

errorCredits.message: Not enough credits on this platform.

errorRunInProgress.message: A run is already in progress.

errorWorkerGone.message: The extension stopped responding, so the run ended. Try again.

hostBlocked.message: $HOST$ is not an http or https page, so it cannot be driven.

noActiveTab.message: $URL$ can’t be driven — only http and https pages can. Switch to the page you want it to work on.

noModels.message: No models are available on this platform.

stepLimit.message: I stopped here: that’s as many steps as I take in one go. Send “continue” and I’ll pick up where I left off, as long as this panel stays open.

tokenLimit.message: I stopped here: that’s as much as I can read in one go. Send “continue” and I’ll pick up where I left off, as long as this panel stays open.

noScriptablePage.message: I can’t read this page — the browser doesn’t allow it. Open the page you’d like me to work on and try again.

errorRealClicksBusy.message: Real clicks can’t start while the developer tools are open on this tab. Close them and try again.

errorRealClicksOff.message: Real clicks were stopped from the bar on the tab or by the developer tools, so the run ended. Try again.
